blocks.text: Sulfuric acid pani mein halne wala aur hygroscopic hai, hawa se pani ke bukharat aasani se jazb karta hai. Anhydrous H2SO4 bohat polar liquid hai. Yeh bohat se maddon ke liye sakht corrosive hai aur jild se lagne par kimiyai jalan deta hai; yeh kapre, plastic, rubber ko buri tarah jala aur jild aur aankhon ko zakhmi kar sakta hai, to ise bohat ehtiyat se sambhalna chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Ghaliz sulfuric acid ko acid pani mein dal kar kyun dilute karna chahiye aur kabhi pani acid mein nahi?
blocks.explanation: Us ka dilute hona shadeed exothermic hai. Ghane acid mein thora pani dalne se pani satah par ubal kar acid chhitakta hai; acid ko pani ki bari miqdar mein aahista, hilate hue, dalna garmi ko pani mein mehfooz taur par phailata hai.

items: H2SO4: be-rang, viscous, be-boo, hygroscopic, anhydrous ho to bohat polar; m.p. 10, b.p. 290 degrees C; specific gravity 1.83; sakht corrosive.
